liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Drum Solo**: rare: 10 archived performances [7]

## The recordings

- **soulive-2005-02-18** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 12 songs; 106 min; rated 3.8/5 by 5 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the sound quality of this recording terrible, despite good playing; Reviewer finds the recording crisp and good, though wanting a bit more soundboard in the mix; Reviewer likes the matrix mix, saying it sounds like the audience-heavy blend described [2][3][5][6]

## Around the show

- The Brakes played an opening set; a listener asks whether the taper recorded it [4]
- A person near the taper's microphones repeatedly shouted phrases about the band and other remarks into them [6]
- Recommends the 6 May 2005 Paradise Rock Club show as better playing with much better sound [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **soulive-2005-02-18**: taped by (((KB))); transferred by (((KB))); source: FOB MATRIX MASTER (85% - FROM STAGE RIGHT + 15% SBD MIX) SBD > ( RCA-1/4 [1]. Also: Source info says this is a matrix mix of roughly 85 percent audience and 15 percent soundboard [5]
